name: Cline
summary: Open-source coding agent that runs in your IDE, terminal and desktop, with plan/act modes and multi-agent teams.
description: Autonomous coding agent available as a VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, CLI, desktop app (macOS/Windows) and Node.js SDK. It edits across a project with checkpoints, runs bash commands, watches linter/compiler errors, supports plan/act modes, .clinerules and skills, multi-agent teams, scheduled agents, Slack/Telegram/Discord chats and MCP or plugin extensions, and works with any model provider.
contains: forms: CLI, desktop app (macOS/Windows), VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, Node.js SDK
plan and act modes with approval or auto-approve
chat integrations: Slack, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, WhatsApp, Linear
works with any model provider incl. local Ollama/LM Studio
